blueprints.description: Projects, tasks and a board for a team: projects as cards with progress, a project page with its tasks and members, a task board, a personal task list grouped by due date and a task side sheet.

screens.name: projects.list
screens.title: Projects
screens.description: Every project as a card with its owner, progress, due date and status.

screens.name: projects.record
screens.title: Project
screens.description: One project: key facts, its tasks and its members.

screens.name: projects.mytasks
screens.title: My tasks
screens.description: The tasks of the signed-in user, grouped by when they are due.

screens.name: projects.board
screens.title: Board
screens.description: Tasks in a column for each status.

screens.name: projects.board.lanes
screens.title: Board by person
screens.description: The same board with a lane for each assignee.

templates.name: ProjectList
templates.description: Projects as cards with owner, a progress bar, due date and status, filtered by owner, status and due date.

templates.name: ProjectPage
templates.description: One project: key facts, its task list, its members and its activity.

templates.name: ProjectMyTasks
templates.description: The user's tasks grouped by due date, with project, priority and status.

templates.name: ProjectTaskBoard
templates.description: Tasks as cards in a column for each status, moved by dragging or by menu.

templates.name: ProjectTaskLanes
templates.description: Tasks in a lane for each assignee and a column for each status.

templates.name: ProjectQuickCreateProject
templates.description: A short form that creates one project without leaving the page.

templates.name: ProjectQuickCreateTask
templates.description: A short form that creates one task without leaving the page.

templates.name: ProjectTaskSheet
templates.description: A side sheet that shows one task: its status, people, fields, subtasks and conversation.
